address: 1F, Block B, Wellness Commercial Plaza, 66 Chengtong Road, Xiangcheng, Suzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: This three-storey lakeside mansion is home to the first haute cuisine establishment of a nationwide dumpling chain. The kitchen and service teams deliver authentic Northeastern flavours and spot-on, friendly service. The two set menus focus respectively on abalone and sea cucumber, alongside seasonal seafood like raw marinated lobster and jellyfish, as well as the must-try sea urchin dumplings that burst with umami.
